# Security Policy — Purity Agency

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 2.x     | :white_check_mark: |
| < 2.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of Purity Agency and our clients' data seriously. If you have discovered a potential security vulnerability, please report it responsibly:

- **E-mail**: [contact@purity-agency.be](mailto:contact@purity-agency.be)
- **Subject**: `[SECURITY VULNERABILITY] <Brief Description>`
- **Canonical security.txt**: [https://purity-agency.be/.well-known/security.txt](https://purity-agency.be/.well-known/security.txt)

### Guidelines
- Please provide detailed steps to reproduce the issue (proof of concept, HTTP requests, affected parameters).
- Allow reasonable time for remediation before any public disclosure.
- Do not exploit the vulnerability beyond what is strictly necessary to demonstrate proof-of-concept.
- Do not access, modify, or destroy user data.

We acknowledge receipt of valid security reports within 24 business hours and prioritize fixes according to severity.
